info.description:
# nopCommerce Analytics & Reporting Studio by nopStation
A powerful, enterprise-grade Nextcloud application designed to seamlessly bridge your **nopCommerce** e-commerce store with your self-hosted **Nextcloud** workspace. Monitor sales, track revenue performance, inspect customer lifetime value, manage fulfillment logistics, and prevent stockouts—all within your private cloud.
---
### 🌟 Key Highlights
- **🔒 100% On-Premise & Data Sovereignty**: All raw e-commerce data (orders, line items, customers, products, and shipments) is synchronized directly into your local Nextcloud database. All KPI calculations and reports run on your server—zero third-party tracking, zero external SaaS dependencies. - **⚡ Real-Time Synchronized E-Commerce**: Supports both on-demand manual sync (Full & Incremental) and automated real-time event updates via HMAC-SHA256 signed webhooks (`OrderCreated`, `OrderPaid`, `CustomerRegistered`, `ProductStockChanged`). - **💼 Enterprise UX & State Persistence**: High-performance Vue 3 interface with deep URL hash routing (`#/dashboard`, `#/reports/summary`, `#/reports/customers`, `#/reports/lowstock`, `#/exports`, `#/settings`) and persistent state across page reloads.
---
### 📊 Core Features
#### 1. Executive Sales KPI Dashboard - **Live Performance Metrics**: Instant cards for Gross Revenue, Net Profit, Total Orders, Average Order Value (AOV), Shipping Fees, and Tax Collected. - **Interactive Multi-Granularity Trends**: Interactive side-by-side charts for Revenue vs. Profit and Order Volumes with Day, Week, and Month grouping. - **Fulfillment & Logistics Intelligence**: Real-time order fulfillment tracker (Delivered, Shipped, Not Yet Shipped, Shipping Not Required) with efficiency rate progress indicator and live dispatch feed.
#### 2. Deep Operational Sales Reports - **Dynamic Period Breakdown**: Group sales performance by Day, Week, or Month. - **3-Level Hierarchical Drilldown**: - **Level 1**: Periodic revenue, tax, and order count summaries. - **Level 2**: Expandable orders table with Order ID, Customer Name/Email, Timestamp, Payment Method, Shipping Method, Discounts, and Status badges. - **Level 3**: Expandable order line items breakdown showing Product Name, SKU, Quantity, Unit Price, and Subtotal. - **Compact Child Pagination**: Clean navigation controls for large order volumes.
#### 3. Customer Segmentation & Analytics - **3-Level Expandable Customer Directory**: Customer profile → Customer orders history → Order line items. - **Flexible Date Range Filtering**: Nullable start and end dates with quick presets (*All Time*, *Last 30 Days*, *Last 90 Days*, *This Year*). - **Segment & Behavior Filters**: Search by Name, Email, or Customer ID; filter by segment (*First-Time Buyers* vs *Returning Customers*); sort by *Highest Spend*, *Most Orders*, *Most Recent Order*, or *Customer Name*. - **Dual Independent Pagination**: Dedicated pagination controls for both the parent customer list and nested order histories.
#### 4. Low Stock Inventory Alerts - **Proactive Stock Monitoring**: Automatically identifies and lists catalog products with inventory levels at or below 10 units to help your team prevent stockouts and backorders.
#### 5. Automated CSV Report Exports - **One-Click Export to Nextcloud Files**: Generate clean CSV reports and store them directly inside your Nextcloud Files storage (`/Files/Analytics/`) for immediate sharing and team collaboration.
---
### ⚙️ Quick Installation & Setup
1. **Install App**: Place `nopstation_analytics` into your Nextcloud server's `apps/` or `custom_apps/` folder, or install directly from the Nextcloud App Store. 2. **Enable App**: Run `php occ app:enable nopstation_analytics` via terminal or enable it through the Nextcloud Apps management screen. 3. **Configure Store Credentials**: - Open **nopCommerce Analytics** from the Nextcloud app header menu. - Go to **Settings & Data Sync**. - Enter your nopCommerce Store Base URL (e.g. `https://your-store.com`). - Enter your REST API credentials (Admin Email & Password or JWT credentials) and click **Save Settings**. - Click **Test Connection** to verify connectivity, then run **Run Full Sync**. 4. **Real-time Webhook Configuration (Optional)**: - In your nopCommerce Webhook plugin, configure endpoints to post to `https://<your-nextcloud>/index.php/apps/nopstation_analytics/api/v1/webhook` with header `X-Nop-Signature` for instant updates.
